name: productcard4
blurb: Product card with image, heart wishlist button, price, and add-to-cart CTA.
description: A product showcase card with large image, title, description, price display, and interactive wishlist heart button with spring animation. Gradient background on hover.
use_when: E-commerce product listings or shopping galleries where heart-toggles and CTA emphasis guide purchase intent.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where heart animation might persist unexpectedly or create accidental toggles.
a11y: Product info is text-readable; image has alt. Heart button has visual state feedback. CTA button is keyboard accessible.
